 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League C - Game Week 5 Nov 12, 2026 - 11:00 Republican Stadium - Vazgen Sargsyan Armenia host Cyprus at the Republican Stadium - Vazgen Sargsyan in Yerevan in a UEFA Nations League C fixture that carries real weight for both sides in the group standings.
 Yegishe Melikyan's Armenia arrive at this match under pressure after a difficult run of results. They have won just one of their last five games, with defeats to Cyprus and Montenegro doing significant damage to their Group 2 campaign.
 Cyprus, managed by Apostolos Mantzios, head into this fixture in sharply contrasting form. They beat Armenia 2-0 in the reverse fixture earlier in October and followed that with a win over Latvia, giving them real momentum at this stage of the competition.
 Armenia will be looking to settle a score at home. Their only home advantage in recent weeks yielded a goalless draw against Montenegro, so Melikyan will demand more from his side in front of their own supporters.
 For Cyprus, a positive result here would consolidate their position in the group and keep their promotion ambitions firmly on track. They have shown they can grind out results, and their recent defensive record gives Mantzios reason for confidence.
 With both sides knowing what is at stake in Group 2, this fixture has clear implications for the final standings. Read on for everything you need to know about how to watch the game.
